title: Friedrichstraße, Erkner
description:
This stunning furnished one bedroom apartment features contemporary design, a fully equipped kitchen, and a cozy living area with breathtaking views. Perfectly situated, you'll have easy access to everything that makes Berlin vibrant and exciting!

Erkner is a peaceful town on the outskirts of Berlin, surrounded by lakes and forests — perfect for outdoor lovers. Despite its calm setting, it’s well connected: the S-Bahn and regional trains take you to Berlin’s city center in under 30 minutes. Shops, cafés, and restaurants are all nearby, making Erkner an ideal choice for those seeking a quiet home with quick city access.

title: Fürstenwalder Allee, Berlin
description:
For a nice and relaxing stay, this apartment offers you a 54m2 large, bright apartment with comfortable furnishings in a prime location. This is in (hidden)ment of a single-family house. All rooms, as well as the kitchen and the bathroom, have windows and a normal ceiling height. 

The spacious apartment can accommodate up to four people. A friendly and appealing interior makes a longer stay a pleasant experience. The apartment has underfloor heating, automatic blinds and WiFi. The kitchen, bathroom and entrance area in the hallway are tiled, laminate is in the bedroom, living room and the rest of the hallway. Smoking in the apartment is not permitted, but possible on the terrace.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore exchanging contact details and offering viewings is not possible. If you would like to reserve this accommodation, send me a booking request or a message and please mention your age and occupation. I look forward to meeting you!
